messages:
Izzy (partnerships): Heads-up: we're lining up a combined HW + SI + press dry-run next week. Need to confirm: staging preview URLs, partner badge copy, SI handoff checklist, and press embargo timing. Suggested slot Tue 09:30 PT. Who's available?
Marco (marketing): I can own hero copy + asset QA. Need partner-approved logos (svg) + a one-sentence quote by Mon EOD. Otherwise I'll ship a neutral hero.
Kei (cloud-ops): I'll spin preview tenants and set ephemeral DNS. ETA: Mon AM. Will keep quotas low during rehearsal.
Nadia (legal): Reminder: logos require a signed addendum. I circulated the addendum link. If partners don't sign, we'll not display logos/quotes.
Raj (solutions): SI runbook v1 almost done. Will include SSO steps, sample data load, and a rollback checklist. I'll also add a 2-step validation that runs during rehearsal.
Izzy (partnerships): Can @Kei confirm preview URLs and @Raj share the runbook by Mon noon so marketing has time to QA?
Kei (cloud-ops): Confirmed. Preview URLs will be posted: https://preview.marketplace.redwood/edgeforge and /deltasys by Mon 09:00 PT.
Marco (marketing): Noted. I'll build two hero variants: one with partner quote + badge and one minimal. Also preparing retina pngs.
Nadia (legal): I'll chase signatures. If we get signoffs, add the logo attribution exactly as in the addendum.
deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled for Tue 07:15 PT -> 07:45 PT. (reaction :rocket:)
Izzy (partnerships): Draft run-of-show for Tue 09:30 PT:
• 09:30 - 09:35 goals & roles (Izzy)
• 09:35 - 09:50 SI onboarding demo + SSO check (Raj)
• 09:50 - 10:05 Provision + smoke (Kei)
• 10:05 - 10:20 Hero + asset QA (Marco)
• 10:20 - 10:30 Press embargo sim & fallback (Nadia)
Please confirm availability.
Raj (solutions): Confirmed. I'll have runbook link and test data ready.
Kei (cloud-ops): Confirmed. Will post preview URLs and monitor quotas.
Marco (marketing): Confirmed. Will bring alternate hero.
Nadia (legal): Confirmed. Will simulate takedown path for embargo leak.
Izzy (partnerships): Action items from thread:
- partner logos + quotes -> owner: Marco / due: Mon EOD
- signed addendum -> owner: Nadia / due: Mon EOD
- preview tenants + ephemeral DNS -> owner: Kei / due: Mon AM
- SI runbook v1 -> owner: Raj / due: Mon noon
Flag blockers here or DM me. :mega:
